plugins.name: idea-to-mvp
plugins.description: Idea → users → use cases → alternatives → solutions → MVP cut → validation → lean PRD. Interactive product-sense flow for PMs.

plugins.name: roadmap-prioritizer
plugins.description: Turn an existing codebase into a prioritized roadmap: status per feature from the code, fresh opportunities from structured ideation, a prioritization model chosen to fit the situation (RICE, MoSCoW, Now/Next/Later or Kano), and an interactive scoring conversation in plain language.
